content: {"reasoning": "The denial is CO-197 (prior auth missing at time of service). This payer offers no retroactive authorization window and no peer-to-peer review, so those paths are closed. An appeal on medical necessity does not cure an administrative missing-auth denial, and resubmitting or correcting again won't help. Since the balance stems from the provider's failure to obtain required auth, it cannot be billed to the patient, and no action can recover the allowed amount—the claim should be closed.", "action": "write_off"}
